text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Local government minister dissolves constituency development fund committees due to financial abuse.
- The closed Lima Bank has been placed under receivership and its board of directors dissolved.
- President Frederick Chiluba rushed to visit the site of Ndola's Indeni petroleum plant where a fuel tank exploded causing some damage.
- President Chiluba says Zambia is heading for an environmental disaster because of pollution in urban areas.
